pages.title: A Battle in Bloom
pages.text: Control a blossom storm area or orbiting koi protection.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find this bow in world loot and read its expanded Alt tooltip. Pain enlarges a stationary storm; Grace gives allies speed/haste; Bounty makes several high-entry-damage fields; Chaos creates orbiting koi that damage and reflect projectiles.
